correctness.rationale: On the invariant eigendirection, the exact global-L FISTA step is multiplication by \(r=1-q\). With \(\beta_1=0\), the first coordinates satisfy \(x_1=rx_0\), \(x_2=r^2x_0\), \(x_3=r^2A(r)x_0\), and \(x_4=r^3B(r)x_0\), where \(A=(1+\beta_2)r-\beta_2\) and \(B=(1+\beta_3)A-\beta_3\). Since \(|A|<1\) on \(0<r<1\), the first three objective comparisons are strict decreases. The fourth rise is equivalent to \((rB-A)(rB+A)>0\); the two quadratic factors have the stated roots \(r_-\), \(1\), and the unique positive \(r_+\), giving exactly \(r_-<r<r_+\). At \(r_0=\beta_2/(1+\beta_2)\), \(A=0\) but \(B=-\beta_3\), so the bare recurrence hits the minimizer at the third point and leaves it at the fourth. The inspected high-precision checker corroborates the root order and direct iterates; the proof is algebraic.
